notes_for_editor: Only two sources: OpenStreetMap node 357997089 (tags; version 3, last edit comment 'Add/modify communication mast. #maproulette' by hwierzbicki, changeset 162130064, which conflicts with the observation tag and suggests the tags may come from a bulk task rather than a lookout record) and an ExpertGPS download page of Mississippi towers (name only). Searches and the NHLR Mississippi index (65 registered lookouts; this name is not in it) found no build date, owner, staffing or condition. Church Hill is also an unincorporated community in Jefferson County (Wikipedia, read only as a lead and not cited). The tower point lies about 6.7 km south of that community's Wikipedia coordinates, so the name link is not shown. GNIS also has a Church Hill populated place in Webster County (feature 705676). Record county is null and the story names no county. Suggested checks: Mississippi Forestry Commission records, the Jefferson County historical society, and recent aerial imagery.
